title: the crypto strategy im using to make millions again.
summary: A crypto influencer predicts a bear-market bottom then a 2027 bull run, urges dollar-cost averaging under key levels, and lists AI-agent, meme-coin and buyback-token narratives as the next plays.

assertions.quote: Bitcoin follows a 4-year having cycle. Every cycle peaks 12 to 18 months post having, then there's often a 12-month correction.

verdicts.note: Three past cycles roughly fit the pattern, but that is too few observations to make it a reliable forecasting rule and ETF-era flows have already changed the dynamics.
Three past cycles loosely fit the pattern, which is too few to call peaks predictable, and ETF-era flows have already broken the timing.

assertions.quote: crypto is really driven by speculation and hype. Other markets have true inherent value.

verdicts.note: Most tokens have no earnings or claim on assets, and academic work finds crypto returns are explained mainly by momentum and attention rather than fundamentals.

assertions.quote: the best course of action for 90% of people who are watching these videos is to simply just dollar cost average

verdicts.note: DCA reliably avoids the timing problem but only pays off if the asset recovers; it does not reduce the risk that crypto stays down or goes to zero.

assertions.quote: This is a market where it is truly the wild, wild west. Things can always go to zero

verdicts.note: Thousands of tokens have gone to effectively zero and even large coins have had 80 percent drawdowns; the risk is well documented.
Multiple boom-bust cycles left a simulated median retail entrant down 48% and 75-81% of users with losses, while a few made large gains; demonstrates severe downside, not positions going to zero.

Bitcoin fell about 65% from the start of January to February 2018 and crypto daily return volatility (0.053) is double that of stocks (0.027) in the sample; confirms high risk without any position going to zero.

assertions.quote: you're able to have a much stronger definitive edge and you're not competing against players who have inside information

verdicts.note: Crypto markets are dominated by bots, market makers, exchanges and insiders with token allocations; studies of retail crypto traders find most lose money.

On-chain data show small holders (<1 BTC) buy as Bitcoin rises while whales and miners sell, so larger and more sophisticated investors profit at retail's expense even in calm periods, and 73-81% of retail entrants likely lost money; retail is the counterparty of insiders, not free of them.

assertions.quote: able to make tens of millions of dollars investing into crypto is by identifying early trends and narratives in this market

verdicts.note: Some early narrative bets have paid off, but the examples are survivorship-selected and most narrative tokens lose the majority of their value after the hype.
The winning examples are survivorship-selected; most narrative and meme tokens lose most of their value and retail buyers rarely get in early.

assertions.quote: The only time that strategy works where you just buy up the dip is when you're already in an uptrending market structure.

verdicts.note: Trend-following has some empirical support, but defining the trend is only clear in hindsight, so the rule is hard to act on in real time.

assertions.quote: those bigger winners will oftentimes make up for the losers that you have

verdicts.note: This is how venture portfolios work, but it requires actually hitting big winners; most retail crypto portfolios do not and the typical account underperforms simply holding Bitcoin.
Power-law portfolios do work this way when a big winner is held, but most retail speculative crypto portfolios underperform simply holding the leading asset.

assertions.quote: one, two, or maybe three different rate cuts which are true liquidity events that do eventually flow back into crypto

verdicts.note: Crypto has correlated with easy money since 2020, but the speaker's own prior thesis on cuts failed and the relationship is loose and lagged.
Crypto prices have moved with easy-money conditions since 2020, but the link is loose and lagged and cuts have not reliably started rallies.

assertions.quote: there are going to be AI agents that are able to help you as a trader or investor make more money than a well-fund manager

verdicts.note: No independent evidence exists that retail AI trading agents beat professionals; the same tools are available to institutions with more data and capital.
